purpose: Define the contract for Hamiltonian or effective-operator evaluation in the first fixed-CI/correlated kernel lane before any accepted correlated operator exists.
required_inputs: assembled or declared correlated basis states
locked operator parameters or explicit no-fit declaration
source-locked target observables and unit conversions
required_outputs: row-level predicted excitation energies or equivalent observables
operator-side uncertainty fields or explicit missing-uncertainty status

required_checks.requirement: The target module exposes the Hamiltonian/effective-operator contract entrypoint.
The contract explicitly depends on the fixed-CI basis-assembly scaffold instead of skipping basis provenance.
The reported effective operator aligns with the selected fixed-CI/correlated operator class.
The contract lists required inputs and outputs explicitly rather than leaving evaluation expectations implicit.
The contract still states that Hamiltonian/effective-operator evaluation is not implemented, so no accepted correlated evaluation claim is allowed.

claim_boundary: This manifest defines the Hamiltonian/effective-operator evaluation contract only. It does not evaluate a correlated Hamiltonian, emit accepted residual rows, or validate a correction operator.
